cd /app && cat > sol.sql << 'EOF'
WITH ws AS (
  SELECT
    s.wordid AS wordid,
    s.synsetid AS synsetid,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    MAX(y.domainid) AS domainid,
    MAX(y.posid) AS posid
  FROM senses AS s
  JOIN synsets AS y ON y.synsetid = s.synsetid
  GROUP BY s.wordid, s.synsetid
),
pw AS (
  SELECT
    wordid,
    COUNT(*) AS total_synsets,
    SUM(cnt) AS total_senses,
    COUNT(DISTINCT domainid) AS distinct_domains,
    COUNT(DISTINCT posid) AS distinct_posids
  FROM ws
  GROUP BY wordid
)
SELECT
  w.wordid AS word_id,
  w.word AS word,
  pw.total_synsets AS total_synsets,
  pw.total_senses AS total_senses,
  pw.distinct_domains AS distinct_domains,
  pw.distinct_posids AS distinct_posids,
  t.synsetid AS top_synsetid,
  t.cnt AS top_synset_sense_count
FROM words AS w
JOIN pw ON pw.wordid = w.wordid
JOIN (
  SELECT
    wordid,
    synsetid,
    cnt,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wordid ORDER BY cnt DESC, synsetid ASC) AS rn
  FROM ws
) AS t ON t.wordid = w.wordid AND t.rn = 1
WHERE pw.total_synsets >= 2
  AND pw.distinct_domains >= 2
  AND pw.total_senses >= 2
ORDER BY
  pw.total_senses DESC,
  pw.total_synsets DESC,
  pw.distinct_domains DESC,
  w.wordid ASC
LIMIT 5
cd /app && time sqlite3 -header -csv oewn.sqlite < sol.sql > .sol_out.csv 2>.sol_err.txt; echo "exit=$?"; wc -l .sol_out.csv; cat .sol_err.txt; diff .orig_out.csv .sol_out.csv && echo "IDENTICAL"
